_comment: Committed reference data for `pvmt validate`. Every figure here is either
externally published or explicitly marked as derived. Sourced from
docs/validation.md §5/§6 and its Sources table; do not add a row without a
citation, and do not tune a row to make the gate pass — the point of the
gate is that it can fail.
paved_area_sqm is DERIVED, not measured: it is back-computed from the §5
table's break-even $/m2 column, which is the tool's own output. It is
adequate as a scale input (it is what the model is asked to price) but it
is NOT an independent measurement, so a residual here is not evidence
about geometry. §1 validates the geometry separately against MTC lane-mile
hold_steady_budget is the only truly independent target, and only Berkeley
has one in citable form — see the §6 'Limit' note. Cities without it are
reported for context and are not gated.

yardstick_per_sqm_year.source: Berkeley 2022 PMP / PTAP-23: $18.3M/yr hold-steady over ~3.3M m2. Bracket matches internal/forecast/backtest_test.go.

cities.name: Berkeley, CA
sources: City of Berkeley 2022 PMP / PTAP-23 Final Report (berkeleyca.gov) — $18.3M/yr to maintain PCI 55, ~$15M/yr current, 214 centerline mi

cities.name: Pleasanton, CA
sources: Pleasanton FY23/24-26/27 CIP programs 24503 + 24504 (cityofpleasantonca.gov) — ~$4.8M/yr (verified); 215 centerline mi / 518 lane mi
